grain_rationale: One source row is one scheduled flight departure: the profile shows row_count 166158 with duplicate_row_rate 0.0, so no exact duplicates need absorbing and no roll-up is required. No single column is unique on its own (flight_number has only 2994 distinct values and tail_number 3825 across 166158 rows), so the identity is derived from the tuple (flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport, sched_dep_hhmm), which together identify a carrier's scheduled departure of a numbered flight from a specific New York origin on a given date at a given scheduled time.

fields.name: flight_date
fields.description: Calendar date of the scheduled flight, never null, spanning 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30 across 181 distinct days.

fields.name: carrier_code
fields.description: Two-character IATA operating carrier code, never null, with 16 distinct values such as AA, DL, UA, B6.

fields.name: flight_number
fields.description: Carrier-assigned flight number from 1 to 8500; a numeric identifier that labels the flight rather than a quantity, so it maps as a dimension.

fields.name: origin_airport
fields.description: Origin airport code, never null, limited to the three New York airports EWR, JFK, and LGA.

fields.name: sched_dep_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled departure clock time encoded as HHMM (500 to 2359); a clock label rather than an additive quantity, never null.

fields.name: dest_airport
fields.description: Destination airport code, never null, with 100 distinct values such as ATL, BNA, and AUS.

fields.name: tail_number
fields.description: Aircraft registration such as N10156; nullable (null_rate 0.009154), likely missing where the operating aircraft was not recorded, for example on cancelled flights.

fields.name: is_cancelled
fields.description: Flag marking whether the flight was cancelled, never null, with both true and false observed in the profile.

fields.name: dep_hhmm
fields.description: Actual departure clock time encoded as HHMM (1 to 2400); nullable (null_rate 0.029388), consistent with flights that never departed because they were cancelled.

fields.name: dep_delay_minutes
fields.description: Departure delay in minutes from -33 (early) to 1301, additive and comparable across flights; nullable (null_rate 0.029388) where no actual departure was recorded.

fields.name: arr_hhmm
fields.description: Actual arrival clock time encoded as HHMM (1 to 2400); nullable (null_rate 0.0307), consistent with cancelled or diverted flights that never arrived.

fields.name: sched_arr_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled arrival clock time encoded as HHMM (1 to 2359); a clock label, never null.

fields.name: arr_delay_minutes
fields.description: Arrival delay in minutes from -86 (early) to 1272, the key additive delay quantity; nullable (null_rate 0.032981) where no arrival was recorded.

fields.name: air_time_minutes
fields.description: Minutes spent in the air, 20 to 695, an additive duration; nullable (null_rate 0.032981) matching flights without a recorded arrival.

fields.name: distance_miles
fields.description: Route distance in miles from 80 to 4983, never null, additive for totals such as miles flown.

fields.name: sched_dep_hour_local
fields.description: Local hour of scheduled departure, 5 through 23, never null; a time-of-day bucket label rather than a quantity.

fields.name: sched_dep_minute_local
fields.description: Local minute of scheduled departure, 0 through 59, never null; a clock label rather than a quantity.

fields.name: departure_hour_utc
fields.description: UTC departure timestamp truncated to the hour (samples all end in :00:00), never null; a secondary time attribute kept as a dimension because flight_date carries the event time.

fields.name: carrier_name
fields.description: Full carrier name with 16 distinct values such as Delta Air Lines Inc. and JetBlue Airways, matching the 16 carrier codes, never null.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacturer
fields.description: Aircraft manufacturer such as BOEING or AIRBUS; nullable (null_rate 0.160426), missing where the tail number did not join to aircraft reference data.

fields.name: aircraft_model
fields.description: Aircraft model designation such as 172N or 550; nullable (null_rate 0.160426), missing alongside the other aircraft attributes.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacture_year
fields.description: Year the aircraft was built, 1956 to 2013; a numeric label of the aircraft rather than a quantity, nullable (null_rate 0.176531).

fields.name: aircraft_seat_count
fields.description: Seat capacity of the operating aircraft, 2 to 450, additive across flights as offered capacity; nullable (null_rate 0.160426) where aircraft data is missing.

fields.name: aircraft_engine_type
fields.description: Engine type with 6 distinct values such as Turbo-fan and Reciprocating; nullable (null_rate 0.160426) alongside the other aircraft attributes.

fields.name: origin_airport_name
fields.description: Full origin airport name, never null, one of the three New York airports such as LaGuardia Airport.

fields.name: origin_municipality
fields.description: Origin city, never null, either New York or Newark.

fields.name: origin_elevation_ft
fields.description: Origin airport elevation in feet with only 3 distinct values (13, 18, 21), an attribute of the airport rather than a flight quantity, never null.

fields.name: origin_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Length of the origin airport's longest runway in feet with 3 distinct values (7002, 11000, 14511), an airport attribute, never null.

fields.name: dest_airport_name
fields.description: Full destination airport name such as Boston Logan International Airport; nullable (null_rate 0.02089) where the destination code did not join to airport reference data.

fields.name: dest_municipality
fields.description: Destination city such as Atlanta or Austin; nullable (null_rate 0.02089) alongside the other destination attributes.

fields.name: dest_iso_region
fields.description: ISO region of the destination such as US-GA or PR-U-A; nullable (null_rate 0.02089) alongside the other destination attributes.

fields.name: dest_elevation_ft
fields.description: Destination airport elevation in feet, 3 to 6606, an airport attribute rather than a flight quantity; nullable (null_rate 0.02089).

fields.name: dest_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Length of the destination airport's longest runway in feet, 5076 to 16000, an airport attribute; nullable (null_rate 0.02089).

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Pipeline capture timestamp, never null, with 16 distinct values clustered in a 15-second window on 2026-09-02; a load-audit attribute, not a business event time.

category_description: One row is one scheduled flight departure from a New York City airport (EWR, JFK, or LGA) in the first half of 2013, carrying its carrier, route, aircraft, schedule, actual times, delays, and cancellation status.
purpose: This mapping declares how silver.silver_flights enters the gold unified event star as the flights fact category at transaction grain, keyed by a derived line identity and timed by flight_date at day grain. Its consumer is the deterministic modeling engine, which renders the gold models from this contract.
usage: The proposal is rendered to an ODCS mapping contract draft, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, gated by the validator and datacontract lint, and reviewed and edited by a human before approval; only then does the modeling engine consume it.
limitations: The mapping does not filter or transform rows: cancelled flights (is_cancelled true) remain in the category with null dep_hhmm, dep_delay_minutes, arr_hhmm, arr_delay_minutes, and air_time_minutes (null rates around 0.029 to 0.033), and excluding them is left to consumers. Aircraft attributes are missing for roughly 16 percent of rows and destination attributes for about 2 percent, and the mapping does not impute them. captured_at is a load timestamp (2026 values), not an event time, and departure_hour_utc resolves only to the hour; the declared event time is flight_date at day grain. No quality rules, classifications, service levels, or ownership are proposed, as the mapping contract carries none by design.
